map.棋盘初始全部盖住，每次翻两张；相同则消除、不同则盖回，全部配对成功过关。关卡越高: The board starts all covered; flip two each turn; if identical they clear, otherwise they cover again; clear all pairs to pass. Higher levels have more pairs.
map.第 1 关 6 对（12 格），全配对过关；第 3 关 10 对（20 格）。记: Level 1 has 6 pairs (12 cells), clear all to pass; level 3 has 10 pairs (20 cells). Record fewest flips and time; more mis-flips mean more steps, and "position coding" reduces re-flipping.
map.翻第一张时就在脑里给位置编号，错配后记住那两张在哪，下次直接配对。: Number positions in your head when flipping the first card; after a mismatch, remember where those two were and pair them next time.
map.翻错会自动盖回，本身即「负向提示」；部分版本提供限时预览。: A wrong flip auto-covers, which is itself a "negative hint"; some versions offer a timed preview.
